preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(x, int) and x >= 0 for x in [n, l, r])
preconditions.description: n, l, and r are non-negative integers where n < 2^50, l ≥ 1, r ≥ 1, and r - l ≤ 10^5
The range l to r is valid (1-indexed)
r is within the maximum possible length of the final list (upper bound for n=2^50-1)

postconditions.expression: stdout == str(sum(1 for i in range(l-1, r) if final_list[i] == 1))
postconditions.description: stdout is the count of 1s in the final list (0-indexed) from position l-1 to r-1 (inclusive), where final_list is the result of repeatedly applying the operation to the initial list [n] until all elements are 0 or 1

postconditions.expression: all(x in {0, 1} for x in final_list)
postconditions.description: final_list contains only 0s and 1s after all operations are applied
